findings.title: Translation LRU cache ignores the fallback chain, so cached results go stale when the default locale changes
findings.body: The cache key on line 72 is built from the key, `config.locale`, and the backend object_id only. With this PR, `translate_no_cache` resolves through `FallbackLocaleList#[]`, whose result depends on `SiteSetting.default_locale` (initializers/i18n.rb line 17). Once a lookup falls back to the site locale or :en, the cached string is keyed as if it were a direct hit for the user's locale. If the admin changes `default_locale`, or a fallback translation is later loaded, existing cache entries keep serving the old result until the process restarts or `reload!` is called. Changing a site setting does not call `I18n.reload!`, so nothing clears the cache. Include the effective fallback chain (or default_locale) in the cache key, or invalidate the cache when the setting changes.

findings.title: ensure_loaded! runs on every request and walks all fallback locales, taking the global mutex each time
findings.body: `ApplicationController#set_locale` now calls `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` on every request. That builds the fallback array (including a SiteSetting lookup) and calls `I18n.ensure_loaded!` for each locale. `I18n.ensure_loaded!` in translate_accelerator.rb calls `load_locale`, which takes `LOAD_MUTEX` whenever the locale is not yet in `@loaded_locales`. After warm-up the check is a cheap array include, so the real cost is small, but the fallback list is recomputed per request on the hot path. It also means set_locale can block on the mutex during a cold load. This is worth a look, but it is not a blocker.

findings.title: Fallback list is computed from SiteSetting at call time without a nil guard for default_locale
findings.body: `SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym` on line 17 is evaluated on every `I18n.fallbacks[locale]` call, including during early boot and in the `ensure_loaded!` path. If the setting is not yet available or is blank in some environments (for example during asset precompilation or in a rake task that runs I18n before the DB is ready), `to_sym` on nil raises NoMethodError, and the failure appears far from its cause. Consider guarding for a blank default_locale.
